title: Idea for directed-energy UFO shootdowns came from a Roswell survivor

tellings.quote: Harold told Pippa on his deathbed and offair that the CIA and Atomic Energy Commission got the very idea of shooting down UFOs with directed energy from an extraterrestrial being that survived the Roswell crash in 1947.

plain: The idea of shooting down UFOs with directed energy, meaning focused beams of energy, is said to have come to the CIA (the US spy agency) and the Atomic Energy Commission (the US body that ran nuclear research after the war) from an alien being that survived the 1947 crash near Roswell, New Mexico. Jesse Michels relays this himself, saying a presidential advisor named Harald Malmgren told it to Pippa Malmgren on his deathbed and off the record. If true, it would mean a surviving being gave the US the very idea of how to bring its kind down.
